notes.title: V1.06 Update inc. Steam Deck enhancements
notes.content:
This update has improvements for Steam Deck, Steam Cloud, and other improvements/fixes. Enjoy!

- Steam Deck: Replaced "Click" in all tutorial text with "Tap".
- Steam Deck: If "Exit Game" is used via the Steam button the game will no longer say "Sorry the game didn't close properly last time." on next boot.
- Steam Deck: The on-screen keyboard will now appear automatically when the player is prompted to enter their name.
- Steam Deck: Replaced "Click to continue" on the first story dialog with "Tap to continue" and made it larger.
- Improved Steam Cloud support so that the first time you play on another device it will pick the first profile in the profile list instead of using a blank profile.
- Updated steam_api.dll and Steamstub.dll
- You can now pass in command line arguments (Steam Launch Options) to change the save data location as follows:
	SaveInDocuments or SaveInAppData or SaveInCGames or SaveInExeFolder
- Made sure that Skip Story button is always in the default state even if it was clicked before.
- Fixed an issue when rapidly clicking the stock pile and obtaining a wildcard.
- Fixed bug where if the Pillars of Order ability changed a knotted card suit locks were not reduced by the correct amount.
- When entering your name the first character is now automatically uppercased.
- Updated the news popup and news icon for Shadowhand Solitaire. We've done this because the best way to let our fans know about our new games is via cross-promotion from the older games and, as an indie micro-studio, every little thing we can do helps.

notes.title: V1.05 Update
notes.content:
- Clicking Newsletter and More Games no longer closes the game to open the browser unless you are in full screen mode.
- Nightmare checkbox label is now dimmed the same as the other checkbox labels.
- Moved news icon higher in draw order so that it draws under any dimming caused by other dialogs such as More Games dialog.
- Defringed the images in the Graphics/News folder.
- Fixed an issue where running the game for the first time would show a dialog saying "Starting in Windowed mode due to incorrect shutdown."
- If the game is closed incorrectly (e.g. from a crash) it will now show a dialog on boot that allows the player to try out an OpenGL graphics driver instead of DirectX, which may work better on some Intel video cards.
- Fixed OpenGL windowed mode so it has a title bar.
- If the game fails to save data it now shows an error message advising players to exclude/whitelist the game/save data folder in their virus killer or One Drive.
- Changed Regency Solitaire II references to "Out Now".

notes.title: Ancient Enemy V1.01 Update
notes.content:
- Added "physical" to Toxic Strike card to clarify damage type.
- Added "fire" word to Flaming Ichor text to clarify it's physical fire damage.
- Clarified that Jar of Leeches also cures poisoned enemies.
- Clarified that Curse spell increases power of skull cards "by 1 per use"
- Clarified that Sun and Moon spell increases power of skull cards "by 1 per use"
- Story fix: descendent -> descendant
- Story fix: from my own shattered body
- Story fix: your are -> you are
- Inventory health tooltip now shows as current/max.
- Added a tooltip to spellbook area that explains you can only learn spells in between chapters.
- Added "Lasts 1 turn." to all defense icon tooltips.
- Added message dialog explaining what power is to hand 2-4.
- Fixed an exploit where if you used undo after ending a combo on a puzzle level it didn't undo the power earned.
- Fixed issue where you could mouse over hidden nodes on the main map and it showed the chapter name on the panel at bottom.
- Fixed issue where if you picked up a bomb/potion on the same puzzle level as a passive ability, the player gained the passive ability instead.
- Fixed issue where if a bomb/potion was found on a puzzle level with a passive ability it wouldn't show floating text to say what it is.
- Fixed issue where the new icon wouldn't show on bombs/potions (or the gear tab) in the inventory after picking them up on a puzzle level.
- Fixed issue where inventory gear tab could still have a new icon on it after you used the new item in a duel.
- Fixed issue where if you entered Unicode characters e.g. Cyrillic in the profile name, the profile would fail to load the next time you played the game. Now only ANSI characters in the range 0-255 are supported (though they may not render if they are not supported in the font.)
- Great and Perfect stars now always end up at the exact same coords after flying on so they never look wonky.
- Improved character sliding onto the game end screen.

notes.title: Ancient Enemy Dev Diary #6: Special Abilities
notes.content:
This week’s video features a roundup of special abilities that we have coded so far in Ancient Enemy.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VJvtbhJbD_4
[list]
[*] The Castle – removes four random cards
[*]  Hammer of the Gods – smashes off targeted card and 2 nearby random ones
[*]  Will-o-the-Wisp – Shuffle
[*]  Hand of Power – converts targeted card into power (power can be used to learn new spells after each chapter)
[*]  Pillars of Power  – changes the suit of all playable cards to match the targeted playable card    
[*]  Glowing Eyes – converts targeted card into a joker 
[*]  Druidic Runes  – changes targeted playable card to your advantage 
[*]  Tree of Fate  – removes all targeted playable cards with the same suit as the targeted card 
[*]  Northern Gale – Blasts off two random cards 
[/list]

As you can see these abilities vary in selectivity, with a card like Glowing Eyes, which has a very specific outcome more targeted than one like Northern Gale, which blasts off ‘random cards’. 

In terms of strength, The Castle is a more powerful version of Northern Gale, as it removes more cards.

Strategic play is very important to get the most out of each move, conserve power and stay a step ahead of your opponent (the opponent's next move is indicated on-screen as you make your decision.) 

For instance, the suits in the game correspond to – and help charge up – your own hand of cards (attack, defense, magic). So playing Tree of Fate and cleaning up all the playable cards corresponding to melee attack will charge up your melee weapon ready to strike!
